## Summary

Describe the problem, the change, and the resulting behavior.

## Related Issues

Link relevant issues, or write "None".

## Validation

List commands run and their results. If checks were not run, explain why.

## Screenshots

For visible interface changes, include screenshots. Otherwise, remove this section.

## Review Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows `AGENTS.md`.
- [ ] Relevant behavior has been verified, with limitations noted above.
- [ ] Documentation and configuration examples are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials or local environment files are included.
